finding.name: Missing Authorization
finding.summary: get_queryset() was widened for is_staff by copying a pattern from an unrelated viewset where that was correct; for tickets, IsTicketOwner.has_object_permission() is the intended sole access rule, but DRF never invokes it for the list action (only from get_object()), so this widening silently exposes every customer's ticket body to any staff account with no ownership or assignment check at all.
